preconditions.description: The length of the input string s must be between 1 and 99.
The length of the input string s must be a multiple of 3.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s must contain only uppercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(1 for i in range(0, len(s), 3) if s[i:i+3] != 'SOS'))
postconditions.description: The output must be the count of altered letters in the received SOS messages.
